SIZE (2069:20328) is drawn OPEN with Width/Height where live has it shut —
the flex container the Insert row creates sets no width or height, so the
section carries nothing. Both sides count four sections in the footer; the
board's four are LAYOUT/FLEXBOX/SIZE/SPACING and live's were
LAYOUT/FLEXBOX/SPACING/VISIBILITY. VISIBILITY was a bug and is fixed (see
below), so live now reads 3 of 13 honestly.
VISIBILITY was open here and on GRID, CONTAINER and MEDIA while all six
profile boards draw it shut. That was a real defect, fixed in this change:
the section declared `styleKeys: [display, visibility, opacity,
pointer-events]` — four properties VisibilitySection never reads — and
omitted the three `--hide-<breakpoint>` custom properties that are all it
reads. `styleKeys` does two jobs: it is what `sectionApplies` counts (so
`display` opened the section for every element that has one) AND what
`defineSection` slices `ctx.styles` down to (so the toggles were handed a
bag that could not contain `--hide-desktop`, always read 'visible', and
could never show the 'hidden on N' preview).

and Flexbox sections use icon tiles and segmented groups, which is a
